response.original_title: 44-204-586-5278 ⟦FAQs ◆ Service Assistance⟧ Can I get a refund if I miss my SWISS flight?
response.overview: Eligibility for SWISS Flight Refund After a Missed Departure Whether you can get a refund for a 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) missed SWISS flight depends on your fare type and the reason for the delay. If you missed the flight due to personal circumstances and held 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) a non-refundable ticket, full fare refunds are generally not granted; however, you may still claim unearned airport taxes and government fees by calling 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK). Passengers with flexible or refundable fares must contact 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) prior to departure to process a refund and avoid total forfeiture.
